name: Elvis Presley

whyMatters.en: Memphis artist filed as band-node: 1954–58 Sun/RCA singles made rock’n’roll a mass US youth format via radio, TV, and film.
whyMatters.zh: 以乐队节点收录的孟菲斯艺人：1954–58 Sun/RCA 单曲经电台、电视与电影把摇滚做成美国大众青年格式。

note.zh: 电视时代全国冲击翻唱。

interviewQuotes.text: I don't know anything about music. In my line you don't have to.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Elvis Presley

lyricQuotes: You ain't nothin' but a hound dog

shortBio.en: Presley rock’n’roll; That’s All Right to Jailhouse Rock mark the breakthrough arc.
shortBio.zh: Presley 摇滚；从 That’s All Right 到 Jailhouse Rock 标记突破弧线。

body.en:
Sun Records sides with Scotty Moore and Bill Black fuse country and R&B; RCA nationalizes the sound; TV appearances and movies scale the image.

That’s All Right (1954), Hound Dog (1956), Jailhouse Rock (1957) are the teaching singles. Later Vegas/comeback eras are separate chapters; this page tracks the rock’n’roll ignition set.
body.zh:
与 Scotty Moore、Bill Black 的 Sun 录音融合乡村与 R&B；RCA 将其全国化；电视与电影放大形象。

That’s All Right（1954）、Hound Dog（1956）、Jailhouse Rock（1957）是教学单曲。后期拉斯维加斯/复出是另章；本页追踪摇滚点火组。

title.zh: 摇滚作为大众青年格式

body.en:
Elvis matters here as the distribution event: regional hybrid music becomes national via new media. Musical materials are Black and white Southern forms in contact.

Catalog of early singles is the chronicle object.
body.zh:
Elvis 在此处要紧的是分发事件：地区混成音乐经新媒体变成全国。音乐材料是南方黑白形式的接触。

早期单曲目录是编年对象。

body.en:
1954 Sun session energy—tempo flip on blues material, Moore’s guitar, Presley’s vocal attack.

Local label, national consequences.
body.zh:
1954 Sun 录音能量——蓝调材料的速度翻转、Moore 吉他、Presley 人声攻击。

本地厂牌，全国后果。

title.zh: Hound Dog：电视时代冲击单曲

body.en:
Big Otis cover rewritten for mass TV; performance controversy is media history beside the arrangement.

Riff and vocal hook at national scale.
body.zh:
改写 Big Mama Thornton 作品打进大众电视；表演争议是编曲旁的媒介史。

全国尺度的 riff 与人声钩子。

body.en:
Later rock inherits the singer-as-brand plus band-as-support model, for better and worse.

DNA is media + rhythm hybrid, not only vocal myth.
body.zh:
后来摇滚继承「主唱即品牌 + 乐队即支持」模型，利弊并存。

DNA 是媒介 + 节奏混成，不只是人声神话。

body.en:
Abundant quotes; useful ones describe work rate and repertoire choice.

Skip fatalistic language.
body.zh:
引语极多；有用的描述工作强度与曲目选择。

跳过宿命论语言。

note.en: Sun Studios flashpoint: country + R&B collide on radio.
note.zh: Sun 录音室引爆点：Country 与 R&B 在电台碰撞。

note.en: Not the inventor of the sound—but the mass-media ignition.
note.zh: 未必发明音色，却点燃了大众媒介。
